% Known-good sheet against ak_unit.json (\problem macro shape): the same
% five declared units, each \answerline inside its problem's stem — proves
% the sheet-side gate segments the \problem shape, not just enumerate.
\documentclass{article}\begin{document}
\problem[4cm]{A ramp rises at $35^\circ$ from a point $9$ ft out. Find the height. \answerline{ft}}
\problem[4cm]{Find the distance between $(1, 2)$ and $(4, 6)$. \answerline{m}}
\problem[4cm]{Find the area of the plot. \answerline{cm$^2$}}
\problem[4cm]{Find the area of the triangle. \answerline{square units}}
\problem[4cm]{Find the measure of angle $A$. \answerline{degrees}}
\end{document}
